description: Our goal as the Titani Martis team is to make the best use of NASA data with the resources we have and to present these findings to humanity in the best possible way. Our team consists of 6 high school students who are interested in astronomy and software, and we are confident that we will have a great time at this hackathon🔭🛰️🪐.
summary:
Titani Martis is an interactive platform that helps users explore Mars and discover places on Earth with similar surface characteristics.

Preparing for future Mars missions requires understanding the planet's terrain. However, studying and testing equipment directly on Mars is difficult and expensive. Earth has many environments that may share similar characteristics with Martian landscapes. Studying these places can help researchers better understand Mars and prepare for future exploration.

Our platform allows users to explore selected regions of Mars through an interactive map and compare their surface features with potential analog locations on Earth. Using planetary and Earth observation data, we aim to examine characteristics such as elevation, slope, and terrain structure to identify possible similarities.

Titani Martis brings this information together in a user-friendly interface with three main features: Mars Explorer, Region Analysis, and Discover and Compare. Users can explore Martian locations, view their characteristics, and investigate potentially similar environments on Earth.

Our goal is to make planetary data easier to understand and demonstrate how Earth observation can support future space exploration. Titani Martis connects our knowledge of Earth with our curiosity about Mars, turning scientific data into an interactive exploration experience.
details:
TITANI MARTIS

Titani Martis is an interactive planetary exploration project developed to investigate the similarities between the landscapes of Mars and Earth. Our mission is to make planetary data more accessible and help users discover how Earth's environments can contribute to our understanding of Mars.

By combining planetary information, Earth observation data, and interactive visualization, we aim to create an engaging platform where users can explore Martian regions and investigate potential terrestrial analogues.

Our platform consists of four main sections, each designed to provide a different part of the exploration experience.

Begin Your Journey Beyond Earth

The Home page introduces users to the world of Titani Martis and explains the purpose behind our project.

Our starting point is a simple but important question: What places on Earth resemble the landscapes of Mars?

Understanding the Martian environment is essential for preparing future robotic and human exploration missions. However, studying Mars directly presents significant challenges. Earth provides a unique opportunity to investigate environments with comparable terrain characteristics and learn more about planetary landscapes.

Through this page, users can discover our mission, understand the importance of terrestrial analogues, and begin exploring the relationship between our planet and Mars.

The Home page serves as the main gateway to the platform, guiding visitors towards the exploration and analysis tools.

Discover the Red Planet

Mars Explorer is the central exploration interface of Titani Martis.

This section allows users to explore selected regions of Mars through an interactive map and discover important geographical and surface features.

Users can navigate between different Martian locations, select regions of interest, and access information about their characteristics. The interface is designed to make planetary exploration more visual, understandable, and accessible.

By presenting Martian regions in an organized way, Mars Explorer provides the foundation for the next stage of our project: comparing these environments with locations on Earth.

Our goal is to transform complex planetary information into an interactive experience that encourages curiosity and scientific discover

Finding Connections Between Two Worlds

The Analysis section focuses on one of the main scientific goals of Titani Martis: identifying potential similarities between Martian landscapes and terrestrial environments.

Different regions of Mars have unique surface characteristics. Some locations may share similarities with deserts, volcanic landscapes, rocky terrains, or other geological environments found on Earth.

Using available planetary and Earth observation datasets, our approach focuses on comparing measurable characteristics such as elevation, slope, and terrain structure.

This section is designed to present these comparisons in a clear and understandable format. Users can investigate selected regions, examine relevant information, and explore why certain locations on Earth may be useful analogues for studying Mars.

It is important to recognize that similar terrain characteristics do not mean two environments are identical. Atmospheric conditions, geological history, temperature, and other factors must also be considered.

By making these similarities and limitations visible, Titani Martis aims to support further investigation and encourage a deeper understanding of planetary environments.

Connect With Our Mission

Scientific discovery grows through collaboration, curiosity, and the exchange of ideas.

The Contact section provides a way for visitors, students, researchers, and space enthusiasts to connect with the Titani Martis team.

We welcome questions, suggestions, feedback, and opportunities for collaboration. Whether you are interested in planetary science, Earth observation, space exploration, or technology, we believe that sharing knowledge can lead to new perspectives and discoveries.

Our project is built around the idea that understanding other worlds begins with studying our own.

Explore with curiosity. Discover with science. Think beyond Earth.
